## PR description
### docs: reorganize vLLM-Omni design navigation
## Summary

- Reorganize the existing vLLM-Omni design navigation into architecture, feature, infrastructure/performance, and module sections.
- Group existing feature designs by runtime and stage execution, communication, diffusion acceleration, parallelism, attention backends, and quantization.
- Link the diffusion quantization section to the existing User Guide quantization overview.

## Why

The design page previously exposed a long flat feature list and mixed documents with different audiences. This structure makes the sidebar and landing page easier to scan while keeping existing document URLs stable.

## Scope

This PR changes only the design navigation and landing-page arrangement. It does not add or modify design documents.

## Validation

- Confirmed the final PR diff contains only `docs/.nav.yml` and `docs/design/index.md`.
- Nav-focused MkDocs build completed successfully, with unrelated existing repository warnings.
- `git diff --check` passes.
